20) ? true : false;
" @resize.window="
$store.checkIfMobile.checkWidth();
" x-init="
$store.checkIfMobile.checkWidth();
showBar = (window.pageYOffset > 20) ? true : false;
" :class="{ 'bg-white transition duration-100 shadow-[0px_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]' : showBar || $store.checkIfMobile.isMobile }"
class="header grid grid-cols-6 xl:grid-cols-24 gap-5 h-[3.75rem] xl:h-[6.25rem] fixed top-0 z-[100] w-full max-w-[120rem] pl-5 2xl:pl-0" x-cloak>

open = false, 150);">
